units.zh: 南齊書卷四十四‧列傳第二十五
units.en: Book of Southern Qi, Volume 44, Biographies 25
units.literal: Book of Southern Qi, Volume 44, Biographies 25

units.zh: 徐孝嗣 沈文季
units.en: Xu Xiaosi and Shen Wenji
units.literal: Xu Xiaosi, Shen Wenji

units.zh: 徐孝嗣字始昌，東海郯人也。
units.en: Xu Xiaosi, whose courtesy name was Shichang, came from Tan in Donghai Commandery.
units.literal: Xu Xiaosi, courtesy name Shichang, was a man of Tan in Donghai.

units.zh: 祖湛之，宋司空；
units.en: His grandfather Xu Zhanzhi had served in the Song as Grand Minister of Works;
units.literal: His grandfather Zhanzhi was Grand Minister of Works in Song;

units.zh: 父聿之，著作郎：竝爲太初所殺。
units.en: his father Xu Yuzhi was a Composition Official; both his father and grandfather were put to death during the Taichu reign.
units.literal: His father Yuzhi was a Composition Official: both were killed in the Taichu era.

units.zh: 孝嗣在孕得免。
units.en: Xiaosi, still in his mother's womb, was spared.
units.literal: Xiaosi, while still in the womb, was spared.

units.zh: 幼而挺立，風儀端簡。
units.en: Even as a child he stood out, with dignified and composed bearing.
units.literal: From childhood he stood erect; his bearing was dignified and proper.

units.zh: 八歲，襲爵枝江縣公，見宋孝武，升階流涕，迄于就席。
units.en: At eight he inherited the title Marquis of Zhijiang; when he was presented to Emperor Xiaowu of Song, he wept as he climbed the steps and continued weeping until he reached his seat.
units.literal: At eight he inherited the fief as Marquis of Zhijiang; when he met Emperor Xiaowu of Song he wept ascending the steps until he took his seat.

units.zh: 帝甚愛之。
units.en: The emperor was deeply fond of him.
units.literal: The emperor was very fond of him.

units.zh: 尚康樂公主。
units.en: He married the Princess of Kangle.
units.literal: He married the Princess of Kangle.

units.zh: 泰始二年，西討解嚴，車駕還宮，孝嗣登殿不著，爲治書御史蔡准所奏，罰金二兩。
units.en: In the second year of the Taishi era, when the western campaign was stood down and the emperor returned to the palace, Xiaosi entered the hall without proper court dress; Supervising Secretary Cai Zhun impeached him, and he was fined two taels of gold.
units.literal: In the second year of Taishi, when the western campaign stood down and the imperial carriage returned to the palace, Xiaosi entered the hall without full attire and was impeached by Supervising Secretary Cai Zhun, fined two taels.

units.zh: 拜駙馬都尉，除著作郎，母喪去官。
units.en: He was appointed Commandant of the Horse Guards for the Imperial Son-in-Law and made Composition Official, then left office on his mother's death.
units.literal: He was appointed Commandant of the Horse Guards for the Imperial Son-in-Law, made Composition Official, and resigned on his mother's death.

units.zh: 爲司空太尉二府參軍，安成王文學。
units.en: He served as a staff officer in the households of the Minister of Works and the Grand Commandant, and as Literary Scholar to the Prince of Ancheng.
units.literal: He served as Retainer in the households of the Minister of Works and the Grand Commandant, and as Literary Scholar to the Prince of Ancheng.

units.zh: 孝嗣姑適東莞劉舍，舍兄藏爲尚書左丞，孝嗣往詣之。
units.en: Xiaosi's paternal aunt had married Liu She of Dongguan; She's elder brother Liu Cang was Left Assistant Director of the Secretariat, and Xiaosi went to call on him.
units.literal: Xiaosi's paternal aunt married Liu She of Dongguan; She's elder brother Cang was Left Assistant Director of the Secretariat, and Xiaosi went to visit him.

units.zh: 藏退語舍曰：「徐郎是令僕人，三十餘可知矣。
units.en: Cang withdrew and told She, "Young Xu is destined for the highest ministerial posts—one can see that already, and he is barely past thirty.
units.literal: Cang withdrew and told She, "Young Xu is material for a chief minister; one can tell that at thirty-plus.

units.zh: 汝宜善自結。」
units.en: You ought to cultivate a bond with him while you can."
units.literal: You ought to cultivate ties with him kindly."

units.zh: 昇明中，遷太祖驃騎從事中郎，帶南彭城太守，隨府轉爲太尉諮議參軍，太守如故。
units.en: During the Shengming period he was promoted to Attendant in the household of Grand Marshal Xiao Daocheng, with concurrent appointment as Administrator of Nan Pengcheng; when the headquarters was transferred he became Consultation Adjutant to the Grand Commandant, retaining his commandery post.
units.literal: During Shengming he was promoted to Attendant in the household of the Grand Marshal Taizu, concurrently Administrator of Nan Pengcheng; when the headquarters moved he became Consultation Adjutant to the Grand Commandant, keeping the same commandery post.

units.zh: 齊臺建，爲世子庶子。
units.en: When the Qi regime was established he was made Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent.
units.literal: When the Qi regime was established he became Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent.

units.zh: 建元初，國除。
units.en: At the beginning of the Jianyuan era his state fief was abolished.
units.literal: At the beginning of Jianyuan the state fief was abolished.

units.zh: 出爲晉陵太守，還爲太子中庶子，領長水校尉。
units.en: He went out as Administrator of Jinling, then returned to serve as Junior Master to the Heir Apparent and as Changshui Colonel.
units.literal: He went out as Administrator of Jinling, returned as Junior Master to the Heir Apparent, and served as Changshui Colonel.

units.zh: 未拜，爲寧朔將軍、聞喜公子良征虜長史，遷尚書吏部郎，太子右衞率，轉長史。
units.en: Before he could take up that post he was made General Who Pacifies the North and Chief Clerk on the campaign staff of Duke Ziliang of Wenxi, then promoted to Director of the Ministry of Personnel, Right Commandant of the Heir Apparent's Guard, and finally Chief Clerk.
units.literal: Before he took office he was made General Who Pacifies the North and Chief Clerk on the campaign staff of Duke Ziliang of Wenxi, promoted Director of the Ministry of Personnel, Right Commandant of the Heir Apparent's Guard, then Chief Clerk.

units.zh: 善趨步，閑容止，與太宰褚淵相埒。
units.en: He walked swiftly yet with easy composure, matching Grand Preceptor Chu Yuan in bearing.
units.literal: He was skilled at quick steps and composed in bearing, on a par with Grand Preceptor Chu Yuan.

units.zh: 世祖深加待遇。
units.en: Emperor Wu of Qi treated him with exceptional favor.
units.literal: Emperor Shizong treated him with special favor.

units.zh: 尚書令王儉謂人曰：「徐孝嗣將來必爲宰相。」
units.en: Director of the Secretariat Wang Jian told others, "Xu Xiaosi will surely become chief minister one day."
units.literal: Director of the Secretariat Wang Jian said to others, "Xu Xiaosi will surely become a chief minister someday."

units.zh: 轉充御史中丞。
units.en: He was transferred to serve as Censor-in-Chief.
units.literal: He was transferred to fill the post of Censor-in-Chief.

units.zh: 世祖問儉曰：「誰可繼卿者？」
units.en: The emperor asked Jian, "Who can succeed you?"
units.literal: Emperor Shizong asked Jian, "Who can succeed you?"

units.zh: 儉曰：「臣東都之日，其在徐孝嗣乎！」
units.en: Jian replied, "From the day I took office in the eastern capital—would it not be Xu Xiaosi!"
units.literal: Jian said, "From the day I took my post in the eastern capital, would it not be Xu Xiaosi!"

units.zh: 出爲吳興太守，儉贈孝嗣四言詩曰：「方軌叔茂，追清彥輔。
units.en: He went out as Administrator of Wuxing; Jian presented Xiaosi with a four-line poem: "Keeping pace with Shumao, pursuing the clarity of Yanfu.
units.literal: He went out as Administrator of Wuxing; Jian presented Xiaosi a four-character poem: "Treading the path of Shumao, pursuing the clarity of Yanfu.

units.zh: 柔亦不茹，剛亦不吐。」
units.en: Gentle, yet he does not yield; firm, yet he does not lash out."
units.literal: Gentle yet he does not yield; firm yet he does not lash out."

units.zh: 時人以比蔡子尼之行狀也。
units.en: People of the time compared this to Cai Zini's letter of recommendation.
units.literal: People of the time compared this to Cai Zini's letter of recommendation.

units.zh: 在郡有能名。
units.en: In the commandery he earned a reputation for capable administration.
units.literal: In the commandery he had a reputation for competence.

units.zh: 會王儉亡，上徵孝嗣爲五兵尚書。
units.en: When Wang Jian died, the emperor summoned Xiaosi to serve as Minister of the Five Arms.
units.literal: When Wang Jian died the emperor summoned Xiaosi to be Minister of the Five Arms.

units.zh: 其年，上敕儀曹令史陳淑、王景之、朱玄真、陳義民撰江左以來儀典，令諮受孝嗣。
units.en: That same year the emperor ordered the clerks of the Bureau of Rites—Chen Shu, Wang Jingzhi, Zhu Xuanzhen, and Chen Yimin—to compile ritual regulations since the establishment of the Eastern Jin, with instructions to consult Xiaosi.
units.literal: That year the emperor ordered clerks of the Bureau of Rites Chen Shu, Wang Jingzhi, Zhu Xuanzhen, and Chen Yimin to compile ritual codes since the Eastern Jin, with instruction to consult Xiaosi.

units.zh: 明年，遷太子詹事。
units.en: The following year he was promoted to Grand Tutor to the Heir Apparent.
units.literal: The next year he was promoted Grand Tutor to the Heir Apparent.

units.zh: 從世祖幸方山。
units.en: He accompanied the emperor on a visit to Mount Fang.
units.literal: He accompanied Emperor Shizong to Mount Fang.

units.zh: 上曰：「朕經始此山之南，復爲離宮之所。
units.en: The emperor said, "I began construction on the south side of this mountain and am again turning it into a detached palace.
units.literal: The emperor said, "I began building on the south side of this mountain and am again making it a detached palace site.

units.zh: 故應有邁靈丘。」
units.en: It ought therefore to surpass Lingqiu."
units.literal: Hence it ought to surpass Lingqiu."

units.zh: 靈丘山湖，新林苑也。
units.en: Lingqiu was the mountain lake within the Xinqin Imperial Park.
units.literal: Lingqiu was the mountain lake of the Xinqin Park.

units.zh: 孝嗣答曰：「繞黃山，款牛首，乃盛漢之事。
units.en: Xiaosi replied, "Encircling Mount Huang and paying homage at Niushou were grand undertakings of the Han dynasty.
units.literal: Xiaosi replied, "Encircling Mount Huang and paying homage at Niushou were grand undertakings of the Han era.

units.zh: 今江南未曠，民亦勞止，願陛下少更留神。」
units.en: Today the south is not yet undeveloped, and the people are still weary—Your Majesty would do well to give the matter a little more thought."
units.literal: Today the south is not yet undeveloped, and the people are still weary; Your Majesty would do well to give the matter a little more thought."

units.zh: 上竟無所脩立。
units.en: The emperor in the end undertook no construction.
units.literal: The emperor in the end undertook no construction.

units.zh: 竟陵王子良甚善之。
units.en: Prince Ziliang of Jingling was very fond of him.
units.literal: Prince Ziliang of Jingling was very fond of him.

units.zh: 子良好佛法，使孝嗣及廬江何胤掌知齋講及衆僧。
units.en: Ziliang was devoted to Buddhism and had Xiaosi and He Yin of Lujiang oversee vegetarian lectures and the monastic community.
units.literal: Ziliang was devoted to Buddhism and had Xiaosi and He Yin of Lujiang manage vegetarian lectures and the monks.

units.zh: 轉吏部尚書。
units.en: He was transferred to Minister of Personnel.
units.literal: He was transferred to Minister of Personnel.

units.zh: 尋加右軍將軍，轉領太子左衞率。
units.en: Soon afterward he was additionally appointed General of the Right Army and transferred to head the Left Commandant of the Heir Apparent's Guard.
units.literal: Soon he was additionally made General of the Right Army and took charge as Left Commandant of the Heir Apparent's Guard.

units.zh: 臺閣事多以委之。
units.en: Most affairs of the central government were entrusted to him.
units.literal: Most matters of the Secretariat were entrusted to him.

units.zh: 世祖崩，遺詔轉右僕射。
units.en: When Emperor Wu died, a testamentary edict transferred him to Right Vice Director of the Secretariat.
units.literal: Emperor Wu died; a testamentary edict transferred him to Right Vice Director.

units.zh: 隆昌元年，遷散騎常侍、前將軍、丹陽尹。
units.en: In the first year of Longchang he was transferred to Attendant Cavalier at Large, General of the Vanguard, and Governor of Danyang.
units.literal: In the first year of Longchang he was transferred to Attendant Cavalier at Large, General of the Vanguard, and Governor of Danyang.

units.zh: 高宗謀廢鬱林，以告孝嗣，孝嗣奉旨無所釐贊。
units.en: Emperor Gao plotted to depose Emperor Yulin and informed Xiaosi; Xiaosi received the command without raising any objection.
units.literal: Emperor Gao plotted to depose Emperor Yulin and informed Xiaosi; Xiaosi received the command without raising any objection.

units.zh: 高宗入殿，孝嗣戎服隨後。
units.en: Emperor Gao entered the hall and Xiaosi followed in military dress.
units.literal: Emperor Gao entered the hall and Xiaosi followed in military dress.

units.zh: 鬱林旣死，高宗須太后令，孝嗣於袖中出而奏之，高宗大悅。
units.en: After Yulin was dead, Emperor Gao needed the empress dowager's order; Xiaosi produced it from his sleeve and presented it, and Emperor Gao was greatly pleased.
units.literal: After Yulin was dead, Emperor Gao needed the empress dowager's order; Xiaosi produced it from his sleeve and presented it, and Emperor Gao was greatly pleased.

units.zh: 以廢立功，封枝江縣侯，食邑千戶。
units.en: For his merit in the deposition he was enfeoffed as Marquis of Zhijiang County with a fief of one thousand households.
units.literal: For his merit in the deposition he was enfeoffed as Marquis of Zhijiang County with a fief of one thousand households.

units.zh: 給鼓吹一部，甲仗五十人入殿。
units.en: He was granted one set of trumpets and drums and fifty armed men authorized to enter the hall.
units.literal: He was granted one set of trumpets and drums and fifty armed men to enter the hall.

units.zh: 轉左僕射，常侍如故。
units.en: He was transferred to Left Vice Director, retaining his post as Attendant Cavalier.
units.literal: He was transferred to Left Vice Director, Attendant Cavalier as before.

units.zh: 明帝卽位，加侍中、中軍大將軍，定策勳，進爵爲公，增封二千戶。
units.en: When Emperor Ming took the throne he was additionally made Palace Attendant and Grand General of the Central Army; for his merit in settling the succession he was advanced in rank to duke with two thousand added households in his fief.
units.literal: When Emperor Ming took the throne he was additionally made Palace Attendant and Grand General of the Central Army; for merit in settling the succession he was advanced in rank to duke with two thousand added households.

units.zh: 給班劔二十人，加兵百人。
units.en: He was given twenty ceremonial guards and one hundred added troops.
units.literal: He was given twenty ceremonial guards and one hundred added troops.

units.zh: 舊拜三公乃臨軒，至是帝特詔與陳顯達、王晏竝臨軒拜授。
units.en: Formerly investiture as one of the Three Excellencies alone warranted approaching the imperial steps; on this occasion the emperor specially ordered that he, Chen Xianda, and Wang Yan together receive investiture before the imperial steps.
units.literal: Formerly only when invested as one of the Three Excellencies did one approach the imperial steps; on this occasion the emperor specially ordered that he, Chen Xianda, and Wang Yan together receive investiture before the imperial steps.

units.zh: 北虜動，詔孝嗣假節頓新亭。
units.en: When the northern enemy stirred, an edict appointed Xiaosi with provisional credentials to hold Xinting.
units.literal: When the northern barbarians stirred, an edict appointed Xiaosi with provisional credentials to hold Xinting.

units.zh: 時王晏爲令，民情物望，不及孝嗣也。
units.en: At that time Wang Yan was chief minister, yet in popular esteem he did not match Xiaosi.
units.literal: At that time Wang Yan was chief minister; in popular esteem he did not match Xiaosi.

units.zh: 晏誅，轉尚書令，領本州中正，餘悉如故。
units.en: When Yan was executed, Xiaosi was transferred to Director of the Secretariat and retained his post as nativist zhongzheng for his home province; all other appointments remained unchanged.
units.literal: When Yan was executed, Xiaosi was transferred to Director of the Secretariat, heading the nativist zhongzheng of his home province, all else unchanged.

units.zh: 孝嗣愛好文學，賞託清勝。
units.en: Xiaosi loved literature and prized refined literary accomplishment.
units.literal: Xiaosi loved literature and prized literary distinction.

units.zh: 器量弘雅，不以權勢自居，故見容建武之世。
units.en: His bearing was broad and refined, and he did not comport himself by rank—hence he was tolerated through the Jianwu era.
units.literal: His capacity was broad and refined, and he did not comport himself by rank—hence he was tolerated in the Jianwu period.

units.zh: 恭己自保，朝野以此稱之。
units.en: He kept himself deferential and secure, and court and countryside alike praised him for it.
units.literal: He kept himself deferential and secure; court and countryside praised him for it.

units.zh: 初，孝嗣在率府，晝卧齋北壁下，夢兩童子遽云「移公牀」。
units.en: Earlier, while Xiaosi was serving in the Guard headquarters, he napped beneath the north wall of his quarters and dreamed that two boys suddenly cried, "Move the lord's couch!"
units.literal: Earlier, while Xiaosi was in the Guard headquarters, he napped by the north wall of his quarters and dreamed two boys suddenly saying "Move the lord's couch."

units.zh: 孝嗣驚起，聞壁有聲，行數步而壁崩壓牀。
units.en: Xiaosi started up in alarm; he heard a sound from the wall, walked a few paces, and the wall collapsed onto the couch.
units.literal: Xiaosi started up in alarm; he heard a sound from the wall, walked a few steps, and the wall collapsed onto the couch.

units.zh: 建武四年，卽本號開府儀同三司。
units.en: In the fourth year of Jianwu he was, while retaining his existing titles, made Equal in Ceremony to the Three Excellencies (kaifu yitong sansi).
units.literal: In the fourth year of Jianwu he was, while retaining his existing titles, made Equal in Ceremony to the Three Excellencies (kaifu yitong sansi).

units.zh: 孝嗣聞有詔，斂容謂左右曰：「吾德慚古人，位登袞職，將何以堪之。
units.en: When Xiaosi heard of the decree he composed himself and told his attendants, "My virtue falls short of the ancients, yet my post reaches the highest ministerial rank—how can I bear this?
units.literal: When Xiaosi heard of the decree he composed himself and told his attendants, "My virtue falls short of the ancients and my post reaches the highest ministerial robes—how can I bear this?

units.zh: 明君可以理奪，必當死請。
units.en: An enlightened ruler can be moved by reason—I shall plead to the death.
units.literal: An enlightened ruler can be persuaded by reason; I shall plead to the death.

units.zh: 若不獲命，正當角巾丘園，待罪家巷耳。」
units.en: If I cannot win his consent, I shall simply don a scholar's kerchief and retire to hill and garden, awaiting punishment in my home lane."
units.literal: If I cannot win his consent, I shall simply don a scholar's kerchief in hill and garden and await punishment in my home lane."

units.zh: 固讓不受。
units.en: He firmly declined and would not accept.
units.literal: He firmly declined and did not accept.

units.zh: 是時連年虜動，軍國虛乏。
units.en: At that time the northern enemy raided year after year, and both state and army were exhausted.
units.literal: At that time the barbarians raided year after year and state and army were drained.

units.zh: 孝嗣表立屯田曰：「有國急務，兵食是同，一夫輟耕，於事彌切。
units.en: Xiaosi submitted a memorial proposing military colonies, writing: "For any state the urgent tasks are the same—arms and grain together; if even one man stops plowing, the harm is all the greater.
units.literal: Xiaosi submitted a memorial proposing state farms: "For a state the urgent tasks are identical—arms and grain together; if one man stops plowing, the harm is all the sharper.

units.zh: 故井陌疆里，長轂盛於周朝，屯田廣置，勝戈富於漢室。
units.en: Hence in Zhou the field boundaries and district lines saw long carriages in abundance; in Han the broad establishment of military colonies made victorious armies rich in grain.
units.literal: Hence field boundaries and district lines saw long carriages abound in Zhou; broadly setting up military colonies made victorious spears rich in Han.

units.zh: 降此以還，詳略可見。
units.en: Since then the detailed accounts and the summaries alike can be seen.
units.literal: Since then the detailed and summary can be seen.

units.zh: 但求之自古，爲論則賒；
units.en: Yet to seek lessons only from antiquity as argument is remote;
units.literal: Yet to seek it from antiquity as argument is remote;

units.zh: 卽以當今，宜有要術。
units.en: for the present day there ought to be essential methods.
units.literal: for the present day there ought to be essential methods.

units.zh: 竊尋緣淮諸鎮，皆取給京師，費引旣殷，漕運艱澀。
units.en: I have traced how all garrisons along the Huai draw their supplies from the capital—the expense is already heavy and transport by water is arduous.
units.literal: I have traced how all garrisons along the Huai draw supplies from the capital—the expense is already heavy and transport by water is arduous.

units.zh: 聚糧待敵，每苦不周，利害之基，莫此爲急。
units.en: To mass grain while awaiting the enemy one often suffers shortage; as a matter of profit and loss nothing is more pressing than this.
units.literal: To mass grain awaiting the enemy one often suffers shortage; as a basis of profit and loss nothing is more pressing than this.

units.zh: 臣比訪之故老及經彼宰守，淮南舊田，觸處極目，陂遏不脩，咸成茂草。
units.en: I have lately questioned old residents and officials who once governed there: the old fields of Huainan, wherever one looks to the horizon, with dikes and sluices unrepaired have all turned to rank weeds.
units.literal: I have lately questioned old residents and officials who governed there: the old fields of Huainan, wherever one looks, with dikes and sluices unrepaired have all turned to rank weeds.

units.zh: 平原陸地，彌望尤多。
units.en: On level plains and open land the wasteland is even more extensive.
units.literal: On level plains and open land the view is even more extensive.

units.zh: 今邊備旣嚴，戍卒增衆，遠資餽運，近廢良疇，士多飢色，可爲嗟歎。
units.en: Now frontier defense is already strict and garrison troops have increased; supplies are brought from afar while good fields nearby lie abandoned—many soldiers show hunger; it is cause for lament.
units.literal: Now frontier defense is already strict and garrison troops increase; feeding them from afar and abandoning good fields nearby—soldiers show hunger; it is cause for lament.

units.zh: 愚欲使刺史二千石躬自履行，隨地墾辟。
units.en: I humbly propose that the provincial governors and the two-thousand-dan officials go in person and open land wherever the terrain allows.
units.literal: I foolishly wish the governors and the two-thousand-dan officials to go in person and open land wherever terrain allows.

units.zh: 精尋灌溉之源，善商肥确之異。
units.en: They should carefully locate sources of irrigation and assess differences between fertile and stony soil.
units.literal: Carefully locate sources of irrigation and gauge differences of fertile and stony soil.

units.zh: 州郡縣戍主帥以下，悉分番附農。
units.en: From garrison commanders and county magistrates downward, all should take turns attached to the farming effort.
units.literal: From garrison chiefs and county magistrates down, all should take turns attached to farming.

units.zh: 今水田雖晚，方事菽麥，菽麥二種，益是北土所宜，彼人便之，不減粳稻。
units.en: Though it is late for rice paddies, beans and wheat can still be planted; both suit the northern soil and the locals know them well, yielding no less than polished rice.
units.literal: Though late for rice paddies, one can still plant beans and wheat; both are what the north prefers and the locals know well, no less than polished rice.

units.zh: 開創之利，宜在及時。
units.en: The benefit of opening new fields lies in acting in time.
units.literal: The profit of opening new fields lies in timeliness.

units.zh: 所啓允合，請卽使至徐、兖、司、豫，爰及荊、雍，各當境規度，勿有所遺。
units.en: What I report is fitting; please immediately send envoys to Xu, Yan, Si, Yu, and also Jing and Yong, to survey each frontier within its jurisdiction and omit nothing.
units.literal: What I report is fitting; please immediately send envoys to Xu, Yan, Si, Yu, and also Jing and Yong to survey each frontier and omit nothing.

units.zh: 別立主曹，專司其事。
units.en: Establish a separate chief clerk office to specialize in this matter.
units.literal: Establish a separate chief clerk office to specialize in the matter.

units.zh: 田器耕牛，臺詳所給。
units.en: Farm tools and plow oxen should be supplied as detailed by the central government.
units.literal: Farm tools and plow oxen—the Secretariat should detail supply.

units.zh: 歲終言殿最，明其刑賞。
units.en: At year's end report achievements and clarify rewards and punishments.
units.literal: At year-end report achievements and clarify rewards and punishments.

units.zh: 此功克舉，庶有弘益。
units.en: If this effort is achieved, there will be great benefit.
units.literal: If this effort is achieved, there will be great benefit.

units.zh: 若緣邊足食，則江南自豐，權其所饒，略不可計。」
units.en: If the frontier has enough food, the south will flourish on its own; estimate how much can be saved—it cannot be reckoned."
units.literal: If the frontier has enough food, the south will flourish on its own; weigh how much can be saved—it cannot be reckoned."

units.zh: 事御見納。
units.en: The memorial was seen and accepted.
units.literal: The memorial was seen and accepted.

units.zh: 時帝已寢疾，兵事未已，竟不施行。
units.en: The emperor was already gravely ill and military affairs had not ceased; in the end the plan was not carried out.
units.literal: The emperor was already gravely ill and military affairs had not ceased; in the end it was not carried out.

units.zh: 帝疾甚，孝嗣入居禁中，臨崩受遺託重，申開府之命。
units.en: When the emperor's illness grew severe, Xiaosi moved into the inner palace; at the verge of death he received a weighty deathbed trust and again pressed the order appointing him Minister of Works with Grand Marshal protocol.
units.literal: When the emperor's illness was severe, Xiaosi moved into the inner palace; at the verge of death he received a weighty deathbed trust and again pressed the order for the concurrent ministry.

units.zh: 加中書監。
units.en: He was additionally appointed Supervisor of the Secretariat.
units.literal: He was additionally made Supervisor of the Secretariat.

units.zh: 永元初輔政，自尚書下省出住宮城南宅，不得還家。
units.en: At the beginning of the Yongyuan era he helped govern; leaving the Secretariat he lodged at his south palace residence within the capital and could not return home.
units.literal: At the beginning of Yongyuan he helped govern; leaving the Secretariat he lodged at his south palace residence in the city and could not return home.

units.zh: 帝失德稍彰，孝嗣不敢諫諍。
units.en: The emperor's misconduct gradually became evident, yet Xiaosi did not dare remonstrate.
units.literal: The emperor's misconduct gradually showed; Xiaosi did not dare remonstrate.

units.zh: 及江祏見誅，內懷憂恐，然未嘗表色。
units.en: When Jiang Shi was executed he harbored worry and fear inwardly, yet never showed it in his expression.
units.literal: When Jiang Shi was executed he harbored worry and fear inwardly, yet never showed it in his face.

units.zh: 始安王遙光反，衆情遑惑，見孝嗣入，宮內乃安。
units.en: When Prince Yaoguang of Shian rebelled, the multitude were agitated and unsettled; when Xiaosi entered the palace, calm returned within.
units.literal: When Prince Yaoguang of Shian rebelled the multitude were agitated and unsettled; when Xiaosi entered the palace calm returned within.

units.zh: 然羣小用事，亦不能制也。
units.en: Yet the petty faction held power, and he could not restrain them either.
units.literal: Yet the petty men held power and he could not restrain them either.

units.zh: 進位司空，固讓。
units.en: He was advanced to Minister of Works and firmly declined.
units.literal: He was advanced to Minister of Works and firmly declined.

units.zh: 求解丹陽尹，不許。
units.en: He requested to be relieved as metropolitan magistrate of Danyang and was not permitted.
units.literal: He requested relief as metropolitan magistrate of Danyang and was not permitted.

units.zh: 孝嗣文人，不顯同異，名位雖大，故得未及禍。
units.en: Xiaosi was a literary man who did not stand out by taking sides; though his rank was great, he therefore escaped disaster for a time.
units.literal: Xiaosi was a literary man who did not stand out by taking sides; though his title was great, he therefore escaped disaster in time.

units.zh: 虎賁中郎將許准有膽力，領軍隷孝嗣，陳說事機，勸行廢立。
units.en: Tiger-Guard Central Commander Xu Zhun had courage and resolution; the army commander was attached to Xiaosi; Zhun explained the situation and urged deposing the emperor and enthroning another.
units.literal: Tiger-Guard Central Commander Xu Zhun had courage and force; the army commander was attached to Xiaosi; Zhun explained the situation and urged deposing and enthroning.

units.zh: 孝嗣遲疑久之，謂必無用干戈理，須少主出遊，閉城門召百僚集議廢之，雖有此懷，終不能決。
units.en: Xiaosi hesitated for a long time, saying there would surely be no need for arms—that when the young emperor went out on a tour they need only shut the gates, summon the hundred officials to council, and depose him; though he harbored this thought, he could never bring himself to decide.
units.literal: Xiaosi hesitated a long time, saying there would surely be no need for arms, that when the young lord went out on a tour they need only shut the gates, summon the hundred officials for council to depose him—though he had this thought he could never decide.

units.zh: 羣小亦稍憎孝嗣，勸帝召百僚集議，因誅之。
units.en: The petty faction also came to dislike Xiaosi and urged the emperor to summon the hundred officials to council and thereby execute him.
units.literal: The petty faction also came to dislike Xiaosi and urged the emperor to summon the hundred officials to council and thereby execute him.

units.zh: 冬，召孝嗣入華林省，遣茹法珍賜藥，孝嗣容色不異，少能飲酒，藥至斗餘，方卒。
units.en: In winter Xiaosi was summoned into the Hualin Park; Ruo Fazhen was sent with poisoned wine; Xiaosi's expression did not change; he could still drink somewhat—more than a dou of the drug before he died.
units.literal: In winter Xiaosi was summoned into the Hualin Park; Ruo Fazhen was sent with poison; Xiaosi's face did not change; he could still drink somewhat—a dou and more of the drug before he died.

units.zh: 乃下詔曰：「周德方熙，三監迷叛，漢歷載昌，宰臣構戾，皆身膏斧鉞，族同煙燼。
units.en: Then an edict was issued: "When Zhou virtue was rising, the three overseers went astray in rebellion; when Han fortune flourished, a chief minister plotted treason—both were minced by the axe, their clans reduced to smoke and ash.
units.literal: Then an edict said, "When Zhou virtue was rising the three overseers went astray; when Han fortune flourished a chief minister plotted rebellion—both were minced by the axe, their clans smoke and ash.

units.zh: 殷鑒上代，垂戒後昆。
units.en: Lessons drawn from prior ages are warnings for later generations.
units.literal: Lessons of prior ages, warnings for later generations.

units.zh: 徐孝嗣憑藉世資，早蒙殊遇，階緣際會，遂登台鉉。
units.en: Xu Xiaosi relied on hereditary standing and early received special favor; riding chance and occasion he ascended the highest ministerial post.
units.literal: Xu Xiaosi relied on hereditary resource and early received special favor; riding chance and occasion he ascended the highest ministerial post.

units.zh: 匡翼之誠無聞，諂黷之迹屢著。
units.en: No loyal service to shore up the throne was ever heard of him, while flattery and overreaching were repeatedly in evidence.
units.literal: No word was heard of loyal assistance; traces of flattery and presumption were repeatedly manifest.

units.zh: 沈文季門世原闕」
units.en: As for Shen Wenji, his house and lineage were originally of humble standing."
units.literal: As for Shen Wenji, his house and lineage were originally of humble standing."

units.zh: 沈文季字仲達，吳興武康人。
units.en: Shen Wenji, whose courtesy name was Zhongda, came from Wukang in Wuxing Commandery.
units.literal: Shen Wenji, courtesy name Zhongda, was a man of Wukang in Wuxing.

units.zh: 父慶之，宋司空。
units.en: His father Shen Qingzhi had served in the Song as Grand Minister of Works.
units.literal: His father Qingzhi was Grand Minister of Works in Song.

units.zh: 文季少以寬雅正直見知。
units.en: From youth Wenji was known for his generous refinement and upright integrity.
units.literal: Wenji from youth was known for generous refinement and upright integrity.

units.zh: 孝建二年，起家主簿，徵祕書郎。
units.en: In the second year of the Xiaojian era he began his career as Chief Clerk and was summoned to serve as Secretariat Gentleman.
units.literal: In the second year of Xiaojian he began as Chief Clerk and was summoned as Secretariat Gentleman.

units.zh: 以慶之勳重，大明五年，封文季爲山陽縣五等伯。
units.en: Because of Qingzhi's great merit, in the fifth year of the Daming era Wenji was enfeoffed as fifth-rank Baron of Shanyang County.
units.literal: Because Qingzhi's merit was weighty, in the fifth year of Daming Wenji was enfeoffed as fifth-rank Baron of Shanyang County.

units.zh: 轉太子舍人，新安王北中郎主簿，西陽王撫軍功曹，江夏王太尉東曹掾，遷中書郎。
units.en: He served successively as Heir Apparent Attendant, Chief Clerk to Prince Xin'an's Northern Central Command, Staff Officer on Prince Xiyang's Pacification Army staff, Eastern Bureau Adjutant on Prince Jiangxia's Grand Commandant staff, and was promoted to Secretariat Gentleman.
units.literal: He became Heir Apparent Attendant, Chief Clerk to the Northern Central Commander of Prince Xin'an, Staff Officer on the Pacification Army staff of Prince Xiyang, Eastern Bureau Adjutant to the Grand Commandant of Prince Jiangxia, and was promoted to Secretariat Gentleman.

units.zh: 慶之爲景和所殺，兵仗圍宅，收捕諸子。
units.en: Qingzhi was killed by Emperor Jinghe (Liu Ziye); armed men surrounded the residence to seize all his sons.
units.literal: Qingzhi was killed by Jinghe; armed men surrounded the residence and seized all the sons.

units.zh: 文季長兄文叔謂文季曰：「我能死，爾能報。」
units.en: Wenji's elder brother Wenshu said to him, "I can die; you must live to take revenge."
units.literal: Wenji's elder brother Wenshu said to Wenji, "I can die; you can take revenge."

units.zh: 遂自縊。
units.en: He then hanged himself.
units.literal: He then hanged himself.

units.zh: 文季揮刀馳馬去，收者不敢追，遂得免。
units.en: Wenji brandished a blade and galloped away; the captors did not dare pursue, and he escaped.
units.literal: Wenji brandished a blade and galloped away; the captors did not dare pursue, and he escaped.

units.zh: 明帝立，起文季爲寧朔將軍、遷太子右衞率，建安王司徒司馬。
units.en: When Emperor Ming took the throne, Wenji was raised as General Who Pacifies the North, promoted to Right Commandant of the Heir Apparent's Guard, and made Staff Major to Prince Jian'an's Minister of Works.
units.literal: When Emperor Ming took the throne Wenji was raised as General Who Pacifies the North, promoted Right Commandant of the Heir Apparent's Guard, and Staff Major to the Minister of Works of Prince Jian'an.

units.zh: 赭圻平，爲宣威將軍，廬江王太尉長史。
units.en: After the pacification of Zhixi he was made General Who Proclaims Might and Chief Clerk to the Grand Commandant of Prince Lujiang.
units.literal: When Zhixi was pacified he was made General Who Proclaims Might and Chief Clerk to the Grand Commandant of Prince Lujiang.

units.zh: 出爲寧朔將軍、征北司馬、廣陵太守。
units.en: He went out as General Who Pacifies the North, Northern Campaign Staff Major, and Administrator of Guangling.
units.literal: He went out as General Who Pacifies the North, Northern Campaign Staff Major, and Administrator of Guangling.

units.zh: 轉黃門郎，領長水校尉。
units.en: He was transferred to Yellow Gate Gentleman and appointed Changshui Colonel.
units.literal: He became Yellow Gate Gentleman and served as Changshui Colonel.

units.zh: 明帝宴會朝臣，以南臺御史賀臧爲柱下史，糾不醉者。
units.en: At a feast for court officials, Emperor Ming appointed Southern Terrace Censor He Zang as pillar chronicler to impeach anyone who failed to become drunk.
units.literal: Emperor Ming feasted the court officials and made Southern Terrace Censor He Zang pillar chronicler to impeach those not drunk.

units.zh: 文季不肯飲酒，被驅下殿。
units.en: Wenji refused to drink and was driven from the hall.
units.literal: Wenji refused to drink and was driven from the hall.

units.zh: 晉平王休祐爲南徐州，帝問褚淵須幹事人爲上佐，淵舉文季。
units.en: When Prince of Jinping Xiu You was assigned to Southern Xuzhou, the emperor asked Chu Yuan for a capable man as chief aide; Yuan recommended Wenji.
units.literal: Prince of Jinping Xiu You was assigned to Southern Xuzhou; the emperor asked Chu Yuan who was a capable man for chief aide, and Yuan recommended Wenji.

units.zh: 轉寧朔將軍、驃騎長史、南東海太守。
units.en: He was transferred to General Who Pacifies the North, chief clerk to the Cavalry General, and Administrator of Southern Donghai.
units.literal: He was transferred to General Who Pacifies the North, chief clerk to the Cavalry General, and Administrator of Southern Donghai.

units.zh: 休祐被殺，雖用薨禮，僚佐多不敢至。
units.en: Xiu You was killed; although the rites for a prince's death were observed, many of his staff did not dare attend.
units.literal: Xiu You was killed; although the rites for a prince's death were used, many staff members did not dare attend.

units.zh: 文季獨往省墓展哀。
units.en: Wenji alone went to visit the tomb and express mourning.
units.literal: Wenji alone went to visit the tomb and express mourning.

units.zh: 出爲臨海太守。
units.en: He went out as Administrator of Linhai.
units.literal: He went out as Administrator of Linhai.

units.zh: 元徽初，遷散騎常侍，領後軍將軍，轉祕書監。
units.en: At the beginning of the Yuanhui era he was transferred to Attendant Cavalier at Large and head of the Rear Army, then made Director of the Secretariat.
units.literal: At the beginning of Yuanhui he was transferred to Attendant Cavalier at Large, heading the Rear Army General, then made Director of the Secretariat.

units.zh: 出爲吳興太守。
units.en: He went out as Administrator of Wuxing.
units.literal: He went out as Administrator of Wuxing.

units.zh: 文季飲酒至五斗，妻王氏，王錫女，飲酒亦至三斗。
units.en: Wenji could drink up to five dou; his wife was a Wang, daughter of Wang Xi, and she too could drink up to three dou.
units.literal: Wenji drank up to five dou; his wife was of the Wang clan, daughter of Wang Xi, and she too drank up to three dou.

units.zh: 文季與對飲竟日，而視事不廢。
units.en: Wenji would drink with her facing each other all day long, yet never neglected his official duties.
units.literal: Wenji would drink facing her all day long yet never neglected his official duties.

units.zh: 昇明元年，沈攸之反，太祖加文季爲冠軍將軍，督吳興錢塘軍事。
units.en: In the first year of Shengming, when Shen Youzhi rebelled, Grand Marshal Xiao Daocheng additionally made Wenji General Who Conquers Champions and supervisor of military affairs in Qiantang, Wuxing.
units.literal: In the first year of Shengming Shen Youzhi rebelled; Grand Marshal Xiao Daocheng additionally made Wenji General Who Conquers Champions and supervisor of military affairs in Qiantang, Wuxing.

units.zh: 攸之先爲景和銜使殺慶之。
units.en: Youzhi had earlier, bearing Emperor Jinghe's grudge, caused Qingzhi's death.
units.literal: Youzhi had earlier, bearing Emperor Jinghe's grudge, caused Qingzhi's death.

units.zh: 至是文季收殺攸之弟新安太守登之，誅其宗族。
units.en: At this time Wenji seized and killed Youzhi's younger brother Dengzhi, Administrator of Xin'an, and executed his entire clan.
units.literal: At this time Wenji seized and killed Youzhi's younger brother Dengzhi, Administrator of Xin'an, and executed his entire clan.

units.zh: 加持節，進號征虜將軍，改封略陽縣侯，邑千戶。
units.en: He was given staff of authority, promoted to General Who Punishes the Barbarians, and re-enfeoffed as Marquis of Lueyang County with a fief of one thousand households.
units.literal: He was given staff of authority, promoted to General Who Punishes the Barbarians, and re-enfeoffed as Marquis of Lueyang County with a fief of one thousand households.

units.zh: 明年，遷丹陽尹，將軍如故。
units.en: The next year he was transferred to Governor of Danyang, retaining his general's rank.
units.literal: The next year he was transferred to Governor of Danyang, general's rank as before.

units.zh: 齊國初建，爲侍中，領祕書監。
units.en: When the Qi state was first established he was made Palace Attendant and concurrent Director of the Secretariat.
units.literal: When the Qi state was first established he was made Palace Attendant and concurrent Director of the Secretariat.

units.zh: 建元元年，轉太子右衞率，侍中如故。
units.en: In the first year of Jianyuan he was transferred to Right Commandant of the Heir Apparent's Guard, retaining his post as Palace Attendant.
units.literal: In the first year of Jianyuan he was transferred to Right Commandant of the Heir Apparent's Guard, Palace Attendant as before.

units.zh: 改封西豐縣侯，食邑千二百戶。
units.en: He was re-enfeoffed as Marquis of Xifeng County with a fief of twelve hundred households.
units.literal: He was re-enfeoffed as Marquis of Xifeng County with a fief of twelve hundred households.

units.zh: 文季風采稜岸，善於進止。
units.en: Wenji's bearing was sharp and commanding, and he was skilled in deportment.
units.literal: Wenji's bearing was sharp-edged and he was skilled in deportment.

units.zh: 司徒褚淵當世貴望，頗以門戶裁之，文季不爲之屈。
units.en: Minister of Works Chu Yuan was the most eminent man of the age and often judged others by family standing; Wenji would not yield to him.
units.literal: Minister of Works Chu Yuan was the age's eminent figure and often measured others by family standing; Wenji did not yield to him.

units.zh: 世祖在東宮，於玄圃宴會朝臣。
units.en: While the future Emperor Wu was still Heir Apparent, he feasted court officials in the Dark Garden.
units.literal: When the Shizong emperor was in the Eastern Palace he feasted court officials in the Dark Garden.

units.zh: 文季數舉酒勸淵，淵甚不平，啓世祖曰：「沈文季謂淵經爲其郡，數加淵酒。」
units.en: Wenji repeatedly urged Yuan to drink; Yuan was deeply displeased and reported to the Heir Apparent, "Shen Wenji says that Yuan once served as magistrate in his home commandery and keeps pressing wine on him."
units.literal: Wenji repeatedly raised his cup to urge Yuan to drink; Yuan was very displeased and reported to the Shizong emperor, "Shen Wenji says Yuan was once magistrate of his commandery and repeatedly pressed wine on Yuan."

units.zh: 文季曰：「惟桑與梓，必恭敬止。
units.en: Wenji replied, "Only the mulberry and catalpa of home—one must approach them with reverence.
units.literal: Wenji said, "Only mulberry and catalpa—one must approach them with reverence.

units.zh: 豈如明府亡國失土，不識枌榆。」
units.en: How unlike Your Excellency, who lost his state and his native soil and no longer knows the trees of home."
units.literal: How unlike Your Excellency, who lost state and land and does not know hometown trees."

units.zh: 遂言及虜動，淵曰：「陳顯達、沈文季當今將略，足委以邊事。」
units.en: The talk then turned to northern incursions; Yuan said, "Chen Xianda and Shen Wenji are the foremost strategists of our day—sufficient to entrust with frontier affairs."
units.literal: They then spoke of barbarian stirrings; Yuan said, "Chen Xianda and Shen Wenji are today's military strategists, sufficient to entrust with frontier affairs."

units.zh: 文季諱稱將門，因是發怒，啓世祖曰：「褚淵自謂是忠臣，未知身死之日，何面目見宋明帝？」
units.en: Wenji resented being called a man of a general's house and in anger reported to the Heir Apparent, "Chu Yuan calls himself a loyal minister—when the day of his death comes, with what face will he meet Emperor Ming of Song?"
units.literal: Wenji resented being called of a general's house and in anger reported to the Shizong emperor, "Chu Yuan calls himself a loyal minister—when the day of his death comes, with what face will he meet Emperor Ming of Song?"

units.zh: 世祖笑曰：「沈率醉也。」
units.en: The Heir Apparent laughed and said, "Shen is drunk."
units.literal: The Shizong emperor laughed and said, "Shen is drunk."

units.zh: 中丞劉休舉其事，見原。
units.en: Censor-in-Chief Liu Xiu impeached him for the incident, but he was pardoned.
units.literal: Censor-in-Chief Liu Xiu impeached the matter; he was pardoned.

units.zh: 後豫章王北宅後堂集會，文季與淵并善琵琶，酒闌，淵取樂器，爲明君曲。
units.en: Later, at a gathering in the rear hall of Prince Yuzhang's north residence, Wenji and Yuan were both skilled at the pipa; when the wine was ending Yuan took up the instrument and played the Bright Lord melody.
units.literal: Later at a gathering in the rear hall of Prince Yuzhang's north residence, Wenji and Yuan were both skilled at pipa; when the wine was ending Yuan took up the instrument and played the tune of the Bright Lord.

units.zh: 文季便下席大唱曰：「沈文季不能作伎兒。」
units.en: Wenji left his seat and sang loudly, "Shen Wenji cannot play the entertainer!"
units.literal: Wenji left his seat and sang loudly, "Shen Wenji cannot be a performer."

units.zh: 豫章王嶷又解之曰：「此故當不損仲容之德。」
units.en: Prince Yuzhang Yi smoothed matters over, saying, "This surely does not diminish Zhongrong's virtue."
units.literal: Prince Yuzhang Yi smoothed it over, saying, "This surely does not diminish Zhongrong's virtue."

units.zh: 淵顏色無異，曲終而止。
units.en: Yuan's expression did not change; when the tune ended he stopped.
units.literal: Yuan's expression did not change; when the tune ended he stopped.

units.zh: 文季尋除征虜將軍，侍中如故。
units.en: Wenji was soon appointed General Who Punishes the Barbarians, retaining his post as Attendant-in-Ordinary.
units.literal: Wenji was soon made General Who Punishes the Barbarians, Attendant-in-Ordinary as before.

units.zh: 遷散騎常侍，左衞將軍，征虜如故。
units.en: He was promoted to Attendant Cavalier and Left Guard General, retaining his post as General Who Punishes the Barbarians.
units.literal: He was promoted Attendant Cavalier, Left Guard General, Punishes-the-Barbarians as before.

units.zh: 世祖卽位，轉太子詹事，常侍如故。
units.en: When Emperor Wu took the throne, Wenji was transferred to Grand Tutor to the Heir Apparent, retaining his post as Attendant Cavalier.
units.literal: When the Shizong emperor took the throne he became Grand Tutor to the Heir Apparent, Attendant Cavalier as before.

units.zh: 永明元年，出爲左將軍、吳郡太守。
units.en: In the first year of the Yongming era he went out as General of the Left and Administrator of Wu Commandery.
units.literal: In the first year of Yongming he went out as General of the Left and Administrator of Wu Commandery.

units.zh: 三年，進號平東將軍。
units.en: In the third year his title was advanced to General Who Pacifies the East.
units.literal: In the third year his title was advanced to General Who Pacifies the East.

units.zh: 四年，遷會稽太守，將軍如故。
units.en: In the fourth year he was transferred to Administrator of Kuaiji, retaining his general's title.
units.literal: In the fourth year he was transferred Administrator of Kuaiji, General as before.

units.zh: 是時連年檢籍，百姓怨望。
units.en: At that time household registers were audited year after year, and popular resentment was widespread.
units.literal: At that time household registers were audited year after year and the people were resentful.

units.zh: 富陽人唐宇之僑居桐廬，父祖相傳圖墓爲業。
units.en: Tang Yuzhi of Fuyang had settled in Tonglu; his father and grandfather had handed down tomb geomancy as their trade.
units.literal: Tang Yuzhi of Fuyang sojourned in Tonglu; father and grandfather had handed down geomancy of tombs as their trade.

units.zh: 宇之自云其家墓有王氣，山中得金印，轉相誑惑。
units.en: Yuzhi claimed that his family tomb bore imperial aura, that he had found a gold seal in the mountains, and he deceived others in turn.
units.literal: Yuzhi claimed his family tomb had imperial aura, that he obtained a gold seal in the mountains, and he deceived others in turn.

units.zh: 三年冬，宇之聚黨四百人，於新城水斷商旅，黨與分布近縣。
units.en: In the winter of the third year Yuzhi gathered four hundred followers, cut off travelers on the waters at Xincheng, and distributed his partisans through nearby counties.
units.literal: In the winter of the third year Yuzhi gathered four hundred partisans, cut off travelers on the waters at Xincheng, and distributed followers in nearby counties.

units.zh: 新城令陸赤奮、桐廬令王天愍弃縣走。
units.en: The magistrates of Xincheng and Tonglu—Lu Chifen and Wang Tianmin—abandoned their counties and fled.
units.literal: The magistrate of Xincheng Lu Chifen and the magistrate of Tonglu Wang Tianmin abandoned their counties and fled.

units.zh: 宇之向富陽，抄略人民，縣令何洵告魚浦子邏主從係公，發魚浦村男丁防縣。
units.en: Yuzhi advanced on Fuyang, plundering the populace; Magistrate He Xun informed the patrol chief of Yupu, Zigong, and mobilized the village men of Yupu to defend the county.
units.literal: Yuzhi moved on Fuyang, plundering the people; Magistrate He Xun informed the patrol chief of Yupu Zigong and mobilized Yupu village men to defend the county.

units.zh: 永興遣西陵戍主夏侯曇羨率將吏及戍左右埭界人起兵赴救。
units.en: Yongxing sent the Xiling garrison chief Xiahou Tanxian, leading officers and men and people from the dam borders, to raise troops for the rescue.
units.literal: Yongxing sent Xiling garrison chief Xiahou Tanxian leading officers and men and people of the dam borders to raise troops for rescue.

units.zh: 宇之遂陷富陽。
units.en: Yuzhi then captured Fuyang.
units.literal: Yuzhi then took Fuyang.

units.zh: 會稽郡丞張思祖遣臺使孔矜、王萬歲、張繇等配以器仗將吏白丁，防衞永興等十屬。
units.en: Kuaiji Assistant Magistrate Zhang Sizu sent capital envoys Kong Jin, Wang Wansui, Zhang Yao, and others, equipping them with arms, officers, and common levies to defend the ten subordinate districts including Yongxing.
units.literal: Kuaiji Assistant Magistrate Zhang Sizu sent capital envoys Kong Jin, Wang Wansui, Zhang Yao and others with arms and officers and common levies to defend the ten subordinate districts including Yongxing.

units.zh: 文季亦遣器仗將吏救援錢塘。
units.en: Wenji also dispatched arms, officers, and troops to rescue Qiantang.
units.literal: Wenji also sent arms, officers, and men to rescue Qiantang.

units.zh: 宇之至錢塘，錢塘令劉彪、戍主聶僧貴遣隊主張玕於小山拒之，力不敵，戰敗。
units.en: When Yuzhi reached Qiantang, Magistrate Liu Biao and garrison chief Nie Sengui sent squad chief Zhang Gan to hold the Little Hill against him; they were outmatched and defeated in battle.
units.literal: When Yuzhi reached Qiantang, Magistrate Liu Biao and garrison chief Nie Sengui sent squad chief Zhang Gan to hold him on Little Hill; strength was unequal and they were defeated.

units.zh: 宇之進抑浦登岸，焚郭邑，彪弃縣走。
units.en: Yuzhi pressed the ford, went ashore, burned the outer wards of the city, and Biao abandoned the county and fled.
units.literal: Yuzhi advanced, pressed the ford, went ashore, burned the outer wards, and Biao abandoned the county and fled.

units.zh: 文季又發吳、嘉興、海鹽、鹽官民丁救之。
units.en: Wenji again mobilized levies from Wu, Jiaxing, Haiyan, and Yanguan for the rescue.
units.literal: Wenji again mobilized levies from Wu, Jiaxing, Haiyan, and Yanguan for rescue.

units.zh: 賊分兵出諸縣，鹽官令蕭元蔚、諸暨令陵琚之竝逃走，餘杭令樂琰戰敗乃奔。
units.en: The rebels sent troops into the various counties; the magistrates of Yanguan and Zhuji—Xiao Yuanwei and Ling Juzhi—both fled; the magistrate of Yuhang, Yue Yan, fled only after defeat in battle.
units.literal: The bandits divided troops into the counties; Magistrates Xiao Yuanwei of Yanguan and Ling Juzhi of Zhuji both fled; Magistrate Yue Yan of Yuhang fled only after defeat in battle.

units.zh: 是春，宇之於錢塘僭號，置太子，以新城戍爲天子宮，縣廨爲太子宮。
units.en: That spring Yuzhi at Qiantang usurped an imperial title, installed a crown prince, made the Xincheng garrison the Son of Heaven's palace, and the county offices the crown prince's palace.
units.literal: That spring Yuzhi at Qiantang usurped a reign title, installed a crown prince, made the Xincheng garrison the Son of Heaven's palace and the county offices the crown prince's palace.

units.zh: 弟紹之爲揚州刺史。
units.en: His younger brother Shaozhi was made Governor of Yang Province.
units.literal: His younger brother Shaozhi was made Governor of Yang Province.

units.zh: 錢塘富人柯隆爲尚書僕射、中書舍人，領太官令。
units.en: Ke Long, a wealthy man of Qiantang, was made Vice Director of the Secretariat and Secretariat Drafter, with concurrent appointment as Director of the Imperial Commissary.
units.literal: The rich man of Qiantang Ke Long was made Vice Director of the Secretariat, Secretariat Drafter, and concurrent Director of the Imperial Commissary.

units.zh: 獻鋌數千口爲宇之作仗，加領尚方令。
units.en: He presented several thousand iron ingots to forge arms for Yuzhi and was additionally appointed Director of the Imperial Workshops.
units.literal: He presented several thousand iron ingots to make arms for Yuzhi and was additionally made Director of the Imperial Workshops.

units.zh: 分遣其黨高道度徐寇東陽，東陽太守蕭崇之、長山令劉國重拒戰見害。
units.en: He sent his follower Gao Daodu to invade Dongyang; Administrator Xiao Chongzhi and the magistrate of Changshan, Liu Guozhong, resisted in battle and were killed.
units.literal: He sent his partisan Gao Daodu to invade Dongyang; Administrator Xiao Chongzhi and Magistrate Liu Guozhong of Changshan resisted in battle and were killed.

units.zh: 崇之字茂敬，太祖族弟。
units.en: Chongzhi, whose courtesy name was Maojing, was a younger clansman of Emperor Gao of Qi.
units.literal: Chongzhi, courtesy name Maojing, was a clansman younger brother of Taizu.

units.zh: 至是臨難，貞正果烈。
units.en: Facing this crisis he was upright, firm, and resolute.
units.literal: At this crisis he was upright, firm, and resolute.

units.zh: 追贈冠軍將軍，太守如故。
units.en: He was posthumously made General Who Conquers the Champions, retaining his title as administrator.
units.literal: He was posthumously made General Who Conquers the Champions, Administrator as before.

units.zh: 賊遂據郡。
units.en: The rebels then occupied the commandery.
units.literal: The bandits then held the commandery.

units.zh: 又遣偽會稽太守孫泓取山陰，時會稽太守王敬則朝正，故宇之謂乘虛可襲。
units.en: They also sent the false Kuaiji Administrator Sun Hong to take Shanyin; as the Administrator Wang Jingze was at court for the new year audience, Yuzhi judged that the moment could be seized.
units.literal: They also sent the false Kuaiji Administrator Sun Hong to take Shanyin; as Kuaiji Administrator Wang Jingze was at court for the new year audience, Yuzhi judged they could strike while the void remained.

units.zh: 泓至浦陽江，郡丞張思祖遣浹口戍主湯休武拒戰，大破之。
units.en: Hong reached the Puyang River; Assistant Magistrate Zhang Sizu sent the Jiaokou garrison chief Tang Xiuwu to resist in battle and routed him utterly.
units.literal: Hong reached the Puyang River; Assistant Magistrate Zhang Sizu sent Jiaokou garrison chief Tang Xiuwu to resist in battle and routed him utterly.

units.zh: 上在樂遊苑，聞宇之賊，謂豫章王嶷曰：「宋明初，九州同反，鼠輩但作，看蕭公雷汝頭。」
units.en: The emperor was in the Leyou Park; hearing of Yuzhi's rebels he told Prince Yuzhang Yi, "At the beginning of Emperor Ming of Song the nine provinces rebelled together—such vermin merely stir; watch how Lord Xiao will thunder at your heads."
units.literal: The emperor was in the Leyou Park; hearing of Yuzhi's bandits he told Prince Yuzhang Yi, "At the beginning of Emperor Ming of Song the nine provinces rebelled together—such vermin merely stir; watch how Lord Xiao will thunder at your heads."

units.zh: 遣禁兵數千人，馬數百匹東討。
units.en: He sent several thousand palace troops and several hundred horses on an eastern campaign.
units.literal: He sent several thousand palace troops and several hundred horses on an eastern campaign.

units.zh: 賊衆烏合，畏馬。
units.en: The rebel host was a mere mob and feared cavalry.
units.literal: The bandit host was a mob and feared horses.

units.zh: 官軍至錢塘，一戰便散，禽斬宇之，進兵平諸郡縣。
units.en: When government troops reached Qiantang, a single battle scattered the rebels; Yuzhi was captured and beheaded, and the army advanced to pacify the commanderies and counties.
units.literal: When government troops reached Qiantang one battle scattered them; Yuzhi was captured and beheaded and the army advanced to pacify the commanderies and counties.

units.zh: 臺軍乘勝，百姓頗被抄奪。
units.en: As the capital troops pressed their victory, the common people suffered considerable plunder.
units.literal: Capital troops riding victory, the common people suffered considerable plunder.

units.zh: 軍還，上聞之，收軍主前軍將軍陳天福弃市，左軍將軍中宿縣子劉明徹免官削爵付東冶。
units.en: When the army returned the emperor heard of it; Forward Army General Chen Tianfu, the army commander, was seized and executed in the market; Left Army General Liu Mingche, Baron of Zhongsu, was dismissed from office, stripped of his title, and sent to Dongye.
units.literal: When the army returned the emperor heard of it and seized army commander Forward Army General Chen Tianfu for execution in the market; Left Army General Liu Mingche, Baron of Zhongsu, was dismissed, stripped of rank, and sent to Dongye.

units.zh: 天福，上寵將也，旣伏誅，內外莫不震肅。
units.en: Tianfu had been one of the emperor's favored generals; once he had been executed, court and countryside alike were awed into discipline.
units.literal: Tianfu was a favored general of the emperor; once he had submitted to execution, within and without none failed to be awed into discipline.

units.zh: 天福善馬槊，至今諸將法之。
units.en: Tianfu was skilled with the cavalry lance; to this day the generals take him as their model.
units.literal: Tianfu was skilled with the cavalry lance; to this day the generals take him as their model.

units.zh: 御史中丞徐孝嗣奏曰：「風聞山東羣盜，剽掠列城，雖匪日而殄，要蹔干王略。
units.en: Censor-in-Chief Xu Xiaosi memorialized: "I hear that bandits east of the mountains are plundering the walled cities; though they may not last a day before destruction, for the moment they disturb the imperial design.
units.literal: Censor-in-Chief Xu Xiaosi memorialized: "I hear that bandits east of the mountains plunder the walled cities; though they may not last a day before destruction, for the moment they disturb the imperial plan.

units.zh: 郡縣闕攻守之宜，倉府多侵秏之弊，舉善懲惡，應有攸歸。
units.en: The commanderies and counties lack proper measures of attack and defense; the granaries show much waste and embezzlement; rewarding the good and punishing the evil ought to have its proper place.
units.literal: Commanderies and counties lack proper measures of attack and defense; granaries show much waste and embezzlement; rewarding good and punishing evil ought to have its proper place.

units.zh: 吳郡所領鹽官令蕭元蔚、桐廬令王天愍、新城令陸赤奮等，縣爲白劫破掠，竝不經格戰，委職散走。
units.en: Under Wu Commandery the magistrates Xiao Yuanwei of Yanguan, Wang Tianmin of Tonglu, Lu Chifen of Xincheng, and others had their counties broken and plundered by daylight robbers; none engaged in battle but abandoned office and fled.
units.literal: Under Wu Commandery the magistrates Xiao Yuanwei of Yanguan, Wang Tianmin of Tonglu, Lu Chifen of Xincheng and others had their counties broken and plundered by daylight robbers, all without engaging in battle, abandoning office and scattering in flight.

units.zh: 元蔚、天愍還臺，赤奮不知所在。
units.en: Yuanwei and Tianmin returned to the capital; Chifen's whereabouts are unknown.
units.literal: Yuanwei and Tianmin returned to the capital; Chifen's whereabouts are unknown.

units.zh: 又錢塘令劉彪、富陽令何洵，乃率領吏民拒戰不敵，未委歸臺。
units.en: Moreover the magistrates of Qiantang and Fuyang—Liu Biao and He Xun—led clerks and people to resist in battle but were outmatched, and have not yet reported back to the capital.
units.literal: Moreover Magistrates Liu Biao of Qiantang and He Xun of Fuyang led clerks and people to resist in battle but were unequal to the foe and have not yet reported back to the capital.

units.zh: 餘建德、壽昌，在劫斷上流，不知被劫掠不？
units.en: As for Jiande and Shouchang, on the upper reaches where the bandits cut the route, it is unknown whether they were plundered?
units.literal: As for Jiande and Shouchang, on the upper reaches where bandits cut the route, it is unknown whether they were plundered or not?

units.zh: 吳興所領餘杭縣被劫破，令樂琰乃率吏民徑戰不敵，委走出都。
units.en: Under Wuxing the county of Yuhang was broken by bandits; Magistrate Yue Yan led clerks and people straight into battle but was outmatched, abandoned his post, and fled to the capital.
units.literal: Under Wuxing the county of Yuhang was broken by bandits; Magistrate Yue Yan led clerks and people straight into battle but was unequal and abandoned his post, fleeing to the capital.

units.zh: 會稽所領諸暨縣，爲劫所破，令陵琚之不經格戰，委城奔走，不知所在。
units.en: Under Kuaiji the county of Zhuji was broken by bandits; Magistrate Ling Juzhi did not engage in battle but abandoned the city and fled—his whereabouts are unknown.
units.literal: Under Kuaiji the county of Zhuji was broken by bandits; Magistrate Ling Juzhi did not engage in battle, abandoned the city and fled, whereabouts unknown.

units.zh: 案元蔚等妄藉天私，作司近服，昧斯隱慝，職啓虔劉。
units.en: Investigation shows that Yuanwei and the others presumptuously relied on imperial favor in offices near the throne, concealed this hidden evil, and in the performance of duty opened the way to slaughter.
units.literal: Investigation shows Yuanwei and others presumptuously relied on heaven's favor in offices near the throne, concealed this hidden evil, and in duty opened the way to slaughter.

units.zh: 會稽郡丞張思祖謬因承乏，總任是尸，涓誠芻效，終焉無紀。
units.en: Kuaiji Assistant Magistrate Zhang Sizu wrongly accepted the post in a vacancy, bore overall responsibility in name only, offered trifling loyalty like grass, and in the end achieved nothing.
units.literal: Kuaiji Assistant Magistrate Zhang Sizu wrongly took on the vacancy, bore overall responsibility as a corpse bears a name, offered trifling loyalty like grass, and in the end achieved nothing.

units.zh: 平東將軍吳郡太守文季、征虜將軍吳興太守西昌侯鸞，任屬關、河，威懷是寄。
units.en: General Who Pacifies the East and Administrator of Wu Wenji, and General Who Punishes the Barbarians and Administrator of Wuxing Marquis Luan of Xichang—their charge was like guarding the passes and rivers; authority and compassion alike were entrusted to them.
units.literal: General Who Pacifies the East and Wu Administrator Wenji, General Who Punishes the Barbarians and Wuxing Administrator Marquis Luan of Xichang—their charge was like the passes and rivers, their authority and compassion were entrusted.

units.zh: 輙下禁止彪、琰、洵，思祖、文季視事如故，鸞等結贖論。」
units.en: I urgently order the detention of Biao, Yan, and Xun; Sizu and Wenji are to continue in office as before; Luan and the others are to be judged after discussion of commutation."
units.literal: I urgently order detention of Biao, Yan, and Xun; Sizu and Wenji continue in office as before; Luan and others are to be judged after ransom discussion."

units.zh: 詔元蔚等免，思祖、鸞、文季原。
units.en: An edict dismissed Yuanwei and the others; Sizu, Luan, and Wenji were pardoned.
units.literal: An edict dismissed Yuanwei and others; Sizu, Luan, and Wenji were pardoned.

units.zh: 文季固讓會稽之授，轉都官尚書，加散騎常侍。
units.en: Wenji firmly declined the appointment to Kuaiji, was transferred to Minister of Justice, and additionally made Attendant Cavalier.
units.literal: Wenji firmly declined the Kuaiji appointment, was transferred Minister of Justice, and additionally made Attendant Cavalier.

units.zh: 出爲持節、督郢州司州之義陽諸軍事、左將軍、郢州刺史。
units.en: He went out with staff of authority as supervisor of military affairs for Ying Province and Yiyang in Si Province, as General of the Left and Governor of Ying Province.
units.literal: He went out with staff of authority, supervising military affairs of Ying Province and Yiyang in Si Province, General of the Left, and Governor of Ying Province.

units.zh: 還爲散騎常侍，領軍將軍。
units.en: He returned to serve as Attendant Cavalier and Army Commander.
units.literal: He returned as Attendant Cavalier and Army Commander.

units.zh: 世祖謂文季曰：「南士無僕射，多歷年所。」
units.en: The emperor said to Wenji, "Southerners have had no Vice Director for many years now."
units.literal: The Shizong emperor said to Wenji, "Southerners have had no Vice Director for many years now."

units.zh: 文季對曰：「南風不競，非復一日。」
units.en: Wenji replied, "The southern wind does not contend—it has not been so for a single day."
units.literal: Wenji replied, "The southern wind does not contend—it has not been for a single day."

units.zh: 文季雖不學，發言必有辭采，當世稱其應對。
units.en: Though Wenji was not a learned man, whenever he spoke his words had literary color; his contemporaries praised his repartee.
units.literal: Though Wenji was not learned, whenever he spoke there was literary color; his age praised his repartee.

units.zh: 尤善簺及彈棊，簺用五子。
units.en: He was especially skilled at bo and at flicking chess pieces; bo was played with five stones.
units.literal: He was especially skilled at bo and at flicking chess pieces; bo used five stones.

units.zh: 以疾遷金紫光祿大夫，加親信二十人，常侍如故。
units.en: Due to illness he was transferred to Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with the Golden Seal, with twenty personal attendants added, retaining his post as Attendant Cavalier.
units.literal: Due to illness he was transferred to Grand Master of Splendid Happiness with the Golden Seal, with twenty personal attendants added, Attendant Cavalier as before.

units.zh: 轉侍中，領太子詹事，遷中護軍，侍中如故。
units.en: He was transferred to Palace Attendant and concurrent Grand Tutor to the Heir Apparent, then promoted to Central Army Protector, retaining his post as Palace Attendant.
units.literal: He was transferred to Palace Attendant and concurrent Grand Tutor to the Heir Apparent, then promoted to Central Army Protector, Palace Attendant as before.

units.zh: 以家爲府。
units.en: His home was made his official headquarters.
units.literal: His home was made his official headquarters.

units.zh: 隆昌元年，復爲領軍將軍，侍中如故。
units.en: In the first year of Longchang he was again made Army Commander, retaining his post as Palace Attendant.
units.literal: In the first year of Longchang he was again made Army Commander, Palace Attendant as before.

units.zh: 豫廢鬱林，高宗欲以文季爲江州，遣左右單景雋宣旨，文季口自陳讓，稱年老不願外出，因問右執法有人未，景雋還具言之。
units.en: Taking part in deposing Yulin, Emperor Gao wished to send Wenji to Jiangzhou and dispatched his attendant Dan Jingjun to announce the edict; Wenji personally pleaded to decline, saying he was old and unwilling to serve abroad, and asked whether anyone had yet been appointed Right Director of Law; Jingjun returned and reported all of this in full.
units.literal: Taking part in deposing Yulin, Emperor Gao wished to send Wenji to Jiangzhou and dispatched his attendant Dan Jingjun to announce the edict; Wenji personally pleaded decline, saying he was old and unwilling to go abroad, and asked whether anyone had yet been appointed to the Right Director of Law; Jingjun returned and reported all this in full.

units.zh: 延興元年，遷尚書右僕射。
units.en: In the first year of Yanxing he was transferred to Right Vice Director of the Secretariat.
units.literal: In the first year of Yanxing he was transferred to Right Vice Director of the Secretariat.

units.zh: 明帝卽位，加領太子詹事，增邑五百戶。
units.en: When Emperor Ming took the throne, Wenji was additionally appointed concurrent Grand Tutor to the Heir Apparent, with five hundred added households in his fief.
units.literal: When Emperor Ming took the throne Wenji was additionally made concurrent Grand Tutor to the Heir Apparent with five hundred added households.

units.zh: 尚書令王晏嘗戲文季爲吳興僕射。
units.en: Director of the Secretariat Wang Yan once teased Wenji as the "Wuxing Vice Director."
units.literal: Director of the Secretariat Wang Yan once teased Wenji as the Wuxing Vice Director.

units.zh: 文季答曰：「琅邪執法，似不出卿門。」
units.en: Wenji replied, "Langye's law enforcement—seems not to come from your own gate."
units.literal: Wenji replied, "Langye's law enforcement—seems not to come from your gate."

units.zh: 尋加散騎常侍，僕射如故。
units.en: Soon he was additionally appointed Attendant Cavalier, retaining his post as Vice Director.
units.literal: Soon he was additionally made Attendant Cavalier, Vice Director as before.

units.zh: 建武二年，虜寇壽春，豫州刺史豐城公遙昌嬰城固守，數遣輕兵相抄擊，明帝以爲憂，詔文季領兵鎮壽春。
units.en: In the second year of the Jianwu era the northern enemy raided Shouchun; the Governor of Yu Province, Prince Yaochang of Fengcheng, held the city firm and repeatedly sent light troops on raiding strikes; Emperor Ming was troubled and ordered Wenji to lead troops to garrison Shouchun.
units.literal: In the second year of Jianwu the barbarians raided Shouchun; Governor of Yu Province the Prince of Fengcheng Yaochang held the city firm, repeatedly sending light troops on mutual raids; Emperor Ming was troubled and ordered Wenji to lead troops to garrison Shouchun.

units.zh: 文季入城，止游兵不聽出，洞開城門，嚴加備守，虜軍尋退，百姓無所傷損。
units.en: Wenji entered the city, halted roaming troops and would not let them sally forth, opened the gates wide, and strictly prepared the defense; the enemy army soon withdrew, and the populace suffered no harm.
units.literal: Wenji entered the city, halted roaming troops and would not let them out, opened the gates wide, strictly prepared defense; the barbarian army soon withdrew and the people suffered no harm.

units.zh: 增封爲千九百戶。
units.en: His fief was increased to one thousand nine hundred households.
units.literal: His fief was increased to one thousand nine hundred households.

units.zh: 尋加護軍將軍，僕射、常侍如故。
units.en: Soon afterward he was additionally appointed General Who Protects the Army, retaining his posts as Vice Director and Attendant Cavalier.
units.literal: Soon he was additionally made General Who Protects the Army, Vice Director and Attendant Cavalier as before.

units.zh: 王敬則反，詔文季領兵屯湖頭，備京路。
units.en: When Wang Jingze rebelled, an edict ordered Wenji to lead troops encamped at Hutou to guard the road to the capital.
units.literal: When Wang Jingze rebelled an edict ordered Wenji to lead troops encamped at Hutou to guard the capital road.

units.zh: 永元元年，轉侍中、左僕射，將軍如故。
units.en: In the first year of the Yongyuan era he was transferred to Attendant-in-Ordinary and Left Vice Director, retaining his general's title.
units.literal: In the first year of Yongyuan he was transferred Attendant-in-Ordinary and Left Vice Director, General as before.

units.zh: 始安王遙光反，其夜，遣三百人於宅掩取文季，欲以爲都督，而文季已還臺。
units.en: When Prince Yaoguang of Shian rebelled, that same night he sent three hundred men to Wenji's residence to seize him by surprise, intending to make him commander-in-chief, but Wenji had already returned to the Secretariat.
units.literal: When Prince Yaoguang of Shian rebelled, that night he sent three hundred men to the residence to seize Wenji by surprise, wishing to make him commander-in-chief, but Wenji had already returned to the Secretariat.

units.zh: 明日，與尚書令徐孝嗣守衞宮城，戎服共坐南掖門上。
units.en: The next day he and Director of the Secretariat Xu Xiaosi guarded the palace city, sitting together atop the South Yeb Gate in military dress.
units.literal: The next day he and Director of the Secretariat Xu Xiaosi guarded the palace city, in military dress sitting together atop the South Yeb Gate.

units.zh: 時東昏已行殺戮，孝嗣深懷憂慮，欲與文季論世事，文季輙引以他辭，終不得及。
units.en: At that time Emperor Dong Hun was already carrying out slaughter; Xiaosi was deeply troubled and wished to discuss affairs of state with Wenji, but Wenji always turned the conversation elsewhere and never reached the subject.
units.literal: At that time Dong Hun was already carrying out slaughter; Xiaosi was deeply worried and wished to discuss affairs with Wenji, but Wenji always turned the talk elsewhere and in the end never reached the point.

units.zh: 事寧，加鎮軍將軍，置府。
units.en: When the crisis was settled he was additionally appointed General Who Pacifies the Army and given a headquarters staff.
units.literal: When affairs were settled he was additionally made General Who Pacifies the Army and given a headquarters.

units.zh: 侍中、僕射如故。
units.en: He retained his posts as Attendant-in-Ordinary and Vice Director.
units.literal: Attendant-in-Ordinary and Vice Director as before.

units.zh: 文季見世方昏亂，託以老疾，不豫朝機。
units.en: Wenji saw that the age was falling into disorder and pleaded old age and illness, declining to take part in court deliberations.
units.literal: Wenji saw the age was in disorder and pleaded old age and illness, not taking part in court deliberations.

units.zh: 兄子昭略謂文季曰：「阿父年六十爲員外僕射，欲求自免，豈可得乎？」
units.en: His nephew Zhaolue said to him, "Uncle, at sixty you serve as supernumerary Vice Director—do you think you can simply seek to exempt yourself?"
units.literal: His nephew Zhaolue said to Wenji, "Uncle, at sixty you are a supernumerary Vice Director—do you think you can seek to exempt yourself?"

units.zh: 文季笑而不答。
units.en: Wenji smiled and did not answer.
units.literal: Wenji smiled and did not answer.

units.zh: 同孝嗣被害。
units.en: Together with Xiaosi he was put to death.
units.literal: Together with Xiaosi he was killed.

units.zh: 其日先被召見，文季知敗，舉動如常，登車顧曰：「此行恐往而不反也。」
units.en: That day he was summoned first for audience; Wenji knew he was ruined, yet his bearing was as usual; mounting the carriage he looked back and said, "This journey—I fear I go and will not return."
units.literal: That day he was first summoned for audience; Wenji knew he was ruined, yet his bearing was as usual; mounting the carriage he looked back and said, "This journey—I fear I go and do not return."

units.zh: 於華林省死，時年五十八。
units.en: He died in the Hualin Park at the age of fifty-eight.
units.literal: He died in the Hualin Park at the age of fifty-eight.

units.zh: 朝野冤之。
units.en: Court and countryside alike considered it a grave injustice.
units.literal: Court and countryside considered it an injustice.

units.zh: 中興元年，贈侍中、司空，謚忠憲。
units.en: In the first year of the Zhongxing era he was posthumously made Attendant-in-Ordinary and Minister of Works, with the posthumous name Loyal and Lawful.
units.literal: In the first year of Zhongxing he was posthumously made Attendant-in-Ordinary and Minister of Works, posthumous name Loyal and Lawful.

units.zh: 兄子昭略，有剛氣。
units.en: His elder brother's son Zhaolue had a forceful nature.
units.literal: His elder brother's son Zhaolue had a forceful nature.

units.zh: 昇明末，爲相國西曹掾，太祖賞之，及卽位，謂王儉曰：「南士中有沈昭略，何職處之？」
units.en: At the end of Shengming he served as Western Bureau Adjutant to the Chancellor of State; the founding emperor admired him, and upon taking the throne said to Wang Jian, "Among southerners there is Shen Zhaolue—what post should he fill?"
units.literal: At the end of Shengming he was Western Bureau Adjutant to the Chancellor of State; the founding emperor admired him, and upon taking the throne said to Wang Jian, "Among southerners there is Shen Zhaolue—what post should he fill?"

units.zh: 儉曰：「臣已有擬。」
units.en: Jian said, "Your servant already has a candidate in mind."
units.literal: Jian said, "Your servant already has a candidate in mind."

units.zh: 奏轉前軍將軍，上不欲違，可其奏。
units.en: He memorialized to transfer him to General of the Vanguard; the emperor did not wish to refuse and approved the memorial.
units.literal: He memorialized to transfer him to General of the Vanguard; the emperor did not wish to refuse and approved the memorial.

units.zh: 尋遷爲中書郎。
units.en: Soon he was transferred to Secretariat Gentleman.
units.literal: Soon he was transferred to Secretariat Gentleman.

units.zh: 永明初，歷太尉大司馬從事中郎，驃騎司馬，黃門郎。
units.en: At the beginning of Yongming he successively served as Attendant in the household of the Grand Commandant and Grand Marshal, Cavalry General's staff major, and Yellow Gate Gentleman.
units.literal: At the beginning of Yongming he successively served as Attendant in the household of the Grand Commandant and Grand Marshal, Cavalry General's staff major, and Yellow Gate Gentleman.

units.zh: 南郡王友、學華選，以昭略爲友，尋兼左丞。
units.en: As Companion to the Prince of Nanjun and a graduate of the Hua selection, Zhaolue was appointed companion; soon he also served concurrently as Left Assistant Director.
units.literal: Companion to the Prince of Nanjun and a graduate of the Hua selection—Zhaolue was made his companion, soon concurrently serving as Left Assistant Director.

units.zh: 元年，出爲臨海太守，御史中丞。
units.en: In the first year of the reign he went out as Administrator of Linhai and Censor-in-Chief.
units.literal: In the first year of the reign he went out as Administrator of Linhai and Censor-in-Chief.

units.zh: 昭略建武世嘗酣酒以自晦，與謝善。
units.en: During the Jianwu era Zhaolue would drink heavily to conceal himself, and was on good terms with Xie.
units.literal: During the Jianwu era Zhaolue would drink heavily to conceal himself, and was on good terms with Xie.

units.zh: 累遷侍中，冠軍將軍，撫軍長史。
units.en: He was repeatedly promoted to Palace Attendant, General Who Conquers Champions, and chief clerk of the Pacification Army.
units.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to Palace Attendant, General Who Conquers Champions, and chief clerk of the Pacification Army.

units.zh: 永元元年，始安王遙光起兵東府，執昭略於城內。
units.en: In the first year of Yongyuan Prince Yaoguang of Shi'an raised troops at the Eastern Palace and seized Zhaolue inside the city.
units.literal: In the first year of Yongyuan Prince Yaoguang of Shi'an raised troops at the Eastern Palace and seized Zhaolue inside the city.

units.zh: 昭略潛自南出，濟淮還臺。
units.en: Zhaolue secretly went out from the south, crossed the Huai, and returned to the Secretariat.
units.literal: Zhaolue secretly went out from the south, crossed the Huai, and returned to the Secretariat.

units.zh: 至是與文季俱被召入華林省。
units.en: At this time he and Wenji were both summoned into Hualin Park.
units.literal: At this time he and Wenji were both summoned into Hualin Park.

units.zh: 茹法珍等進藥酒，昭略怒罵徐孝嗣曰：「廢昏立明，古今令典。
units.en: Ru Fazhen and others brought poisoned wine; Zhaolue angrily cursed Xu Xiaosi, saying, "Deposing the benighted and installing the enlightened is a worthy model of past and present.
units.literal: Ru Fazhen and others brought poisoned wine; Zhaolue angrily cursed Xu Xiaosi, saying, "Deposing the benighted and installing the enlightened is a worthy model of past and present.

units.zh: 宰相無才，致有今日。」
units.en: The chief minister lacked talent and brought about this day."
units.literal: The chief minister lacked talent and brought about this day."

units.zh: 以甌擲面破，曰「作破面鬼」。
units.en: He hurled a bowl, breaking Xiaosi's face, and said, "Become a face-broken ghost."
units.literal: He hurled a bowl, breaking Xiaosi's face, and said, "Become a face-broken ghost."

units.zh: 死時年四十餘。
units.en: He died aged a little over forty.
units.literal: He died aged a little over forty.

units.zh: 弟昭光，聞收至，家人勸逃去，昭光不忍捨母，遂見獲，殺之。
units.en: His younger brother Zhaoguang, hearing that arrests were coming, was urged by his family to flee; Zhaoguang could not bear to abandon his mother, was seized, and put to death.
units.literal: His younger brother Zhaoguang, hearing the arrest was coming, was urged by family to flee; Zhaoguang could not bear to abandon his mother, was seized, and killed.

units.zh: 中興元年，贈昭略太常，昭光廷尉。
units.en: In the first year of the Zhongxing era Zhaolue was posthumously made Grand Minister of Ceremonies and Zhaoguang Director of Justice.
units.literal: In the first year of Zhongxing Zhaolue was posthumously made Grand Minister of Ceremonies and Zhaoguang Director of Justice.

units.zh: 史臣曰：爲邦之訓，食惟民天，足食足兵，民信之矣。
units.en: The historiographer says: The teaching for governing a state is that food is the people's heaven—with sufficient food and sufficient arms, the people will place their trust.
units.literal: The historiographer says: The instruction for governing a state is that food is the people's heaven; with sufficient food and sufficient arms, the people will trust it.

units.zh: 屯田之略，實重戰守。
units.en: The strategy of military colonies truly gives weight to both warfare and defense.
units.literal: The strategy of military colonies truly weighs warfare and defense heavily.

units.zh: 若夫充國耕殖，用殄羌戎，韓浩、棗祇，亦建華夏置典農之官，興大佃之議。
units.en: Zhao Chongguo farmed the frontier and thereby extinguished the Qiang; Han Hao and Zao Zhi likewise established the Central States, created the office of Director of Agriculture, and advanced the proposal of great land reclamation.
units.literal: As for Zhao Chongguo's farming to exterminate the Qiang barbarians, Han Hao and Zao Zhi also established the Central States, set up the office of Director of Agriculture, and raised the proposal of great land reclamation.

units.zh: 金城布險，峻壘綿疆，飛芻輓粒，事難支繼。
units.en: At Jincheng defenses are spread wide and lofty ramparts span the borders; flying fodder and hauling grain by cart—the effort is hard to sustain.
units.literal: Jincheng spreads defenses, lofty ramparts span the borders; flying fodder and hauling grain—the affair is hard to sustain.

units.zh: 一夫不耕，或鍾飢餒，緣邊戍卒，坐甲千羣。
units.en: If even one man does not plow, hunger may follow; along the frontier garrison soldiers sit in armor by the thousands.
units.literal: If one man does not plow, hunger may strike; along the frontier garrison soldiers sit in armor by the thousands.

units.zh: 故宜盡收地利，因兵務食。
units.en: Hence one ought fully to harvest the land's advantage and through military effort secure food.
units.literal: Hence one ought fully to harvest the land's profit and through arms pursue food.

units.zh: 緩則躬耕，急則從戰。
units.en: In times of calm they plow in person; in times of urgency they follow into battle.
units.literal: In calm they plow in person; in urgency they follow into battle.

units.zh: 歲有餘糧，則紅食可待。
units.en: When the year yields surplus grain, army provisions can be kept in readiness.
units.literal: When the year yields surplus grain, army provisions can be kept in readiness.

units.zh: 前世達治，言之已詳。
units.en: Former ages of enlightened rule have already spoken of this in detail.
units.literal: Former ages of enlightened rule have spoken of this in detail.

units.zh: 江左以來，不暇遠策，王旅外出，未嘗宿飽，四郊嬰守，懼等松芻。
units.en: Since the establishment of the Eastern Jin there has been no leisure for distant strategy; the imperial armies march out and have never slept on a full stomach; the four suburbs cling to defense, fearing starvation like dry pine fodder.
units.literal: Since the establishment of the Eastern Jin there has been no leisure for distant strategy; the royal host goes out and has never slept full; the four suburbs cling to defense, fearing they equal pine fodder.

units.zh: 縣兵所救，經歲引日，淩風泙水，轉漕艱長。
units.en: What county troops can rescue takes months on end; braving wind and fording floodwaters, transport by water is arduous and prolonged.
units.literal: What county troops can rescue stretches year-long days; braving wind and fording floodwaters, transport by water is arduous and long.

units.zh: 傾窖底之儲，盡倉敖之粟，流馬木牛，尚深前弊，田積之要，唯在江淮。
units.en: Emptying the depths of the cellars and exhausting the granaries, even with flowing horses and wooden oxen the old evils remain deep; the key to accumulated fields lies only in the Yangtze and Huai region.
units.literal: Emptying the bottom of cellars, exhausting granary grain, flowing horses and wooden oxen—still the former evils run deep; the key to amassed fields lies only in the Yangtze and Huai.

units.zh: 郡國同興，遠不周急。
units.en: When commanderies and states rise together, distant efforts do not meet urgent needs.
units.literal: When commanderies and states rise together, the distant does not meet the urgent.

units.zh: 故吳氏列戍南濱，屯農水右，魏世淮北大佃，而石橫開漕，皆輔車相資，易以待敵。
units.en: Hence the house of Wu arrayed garrisons on the southern shore and farmed the lands on the water's right; in Wei times there was great land reclamation north of the Huai, and Shi Heng opened the transport canal—all supported one another like paired wheels, making it easier to await the enemy.
units.literal: Hence the Wu house arrayed garrisons on the southern shore, military farming on the water's right; in Wei times great land reclamation on the north Huai, and Shi Heng opened the transport canal—all aided one another like cheek and cart, making it easy to await the enemy.

units.zh: 孝嗣當蹙境之晨，薦希行之計，王無外略，民困首領，觀機而動，斯議殆爲空陳，惜矣！
units.en: Xiaosi, at the dawn of a straitened frontier, recommended a plan rarely put into practice; the ruler had no external strategy and the people were distressed at the top—watching for the moment to act—this proposal was nearly an empty statement. A pity!
units.literal: Xiaosi at the dawn of a straitened frontier recommended a plan rarely practiced; the king had no external strategy, the people were distressed at the head, watching the moment to act—this proposal was nearly an empty statement. Pity!

units.zh: 贊曰：文忠作相，器範先標。
units.en: Eulogy: As chief minister Wenzhong set the standard of capacity and bearing.
units.literal: Eulogy says: Wenzhong served as chief minister; capacity and model were foremost in mark.

units.zh: 有容有業，可以立朝。
units.en: With bearing and achievement, he was fit to stand at court.
units.literal: He had bearing and achievement, fit to stand at court.

units.zh: 豐城歷仕，音儀孔昭。
units.en: Through successive reigns at Fengcheng his voice and bearing shone brilliantly.
units.literal: Fengcheng served through successive reigns; voice and bearing were brilliantly manifest.

units.zh: 爲舟等溺，在運同消。
units.en: Like boats drowned together, in fate they alike vanished.
units.literal: Like boats drowned together, in fate they alike vanished.
